title: Strong Malthusian convergence in L1 for conservative growth-fragmentations with bounded fission and a strict boundary growth gap
author: Jean Bertoin; Alexander R. Watson
work: The strong Malthusian behavior of growth-fragmentation processes

difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an h-biased spine and derives second-moment bounds for a potentially infinitely branching system, combines compact tightness with uniform ergodicity, and controls conditional fluctuations to obtain strong random-measure convergence. This branching-process and Feynman–Kac analysis exceeds ordinary qualifying examinations.
